en: The front side of the postcard shows a black and white photograph of a winter scene outside a corner building with large windows. Above the windows and doorway are large signs reading 'Bergströms Pälsvaror' (Bergström's Fur Goods). Two people, a woman and a man in a white coat, stand in the doorway. The ground is covered in snow. The reverse side includes handwritten Swedish text, a 10 öre Swedish stamp with a lion motif, and the address 'Herr Thure Spotz, A.Baf Komum, Vasagatan, Stockholm' in neat cursive writing. There is a postmark partially visible.
